additional_info.subject: ID0437397-DC/Si-D/AT-[RVP/T5170004820] Newly commissioned  charger showing error CRM:02919000165
additional_info.body:
Hi Johannes,
I checked the charger remotely and it seems like one of the temperature sensors is not reading properly:
Please measure on site the PT1000 here:
Should be between blue and orange because in the WebUI it doesn't specifically say which one it is.
If the value 1kOhm is coming to XD410:9B then it means that it's being lost until the StateMonitor. Please check the 1kOhm until the KF14 and if it reaches there, please trial a spare grey connector that is unused in the KF14.
If this still doesn't work replace KF14.
If the value 1kOhm is not coming to XD410:9B then the sensor is faulty and needs full replacement.
If you need assistance on site please let me know with 1 day in advance. I will send this ticket to you.
Best regards,
Francisco

My guess is that the grey connector on ECOG was a little bit losse.
